marc:datafield.marc:subfield: LAIN daRI yaNg LAIN. EPISOD 8. SIRI 8.

Contains 3 segments: SEGMENT 1 This week's showcase highlights the actions of a senior citizen with extraordinary strength, capable of stopping a coconut grating machine, cracking coconut shells, and bending iron using only their bare hands. SEGMENT 2 Classic motorcycles of various brands make up the collection of a resident in Klebang, Melaka. The uniqueness of these motorcycles and a deep passion drive individuals to spend heavily to acquire these classic bikes. SEGMENT 3 A fishing competition was held as a way to strengthen community ties among the villagers. Organized by the village's JKKK (Village Security and Development Committee), this competition was held for the very first time.
